name: Gacha Story
summary: Create your own visual novels, export and import your friend's stories, or check out the community's top VNs! You can also create your own characters or upload your own creations into the game! Choose a scene category first, either a Title scene, Dialogue scene, Choice scene, or a new Route Branch scene! Then add your background, characters, and text! Next you can add background music and sound effects to your scene! The possibilities are endless in Gacha Story!
